article_context: 文章介绍通过再生农业生产的“气候友好型鸡蛋”：利用土壤、覆盖作物与放养体系减碳，并讨论消费者是否愿意为这种可持续属性支付溢价。

article.title: 阅读 Text 1 · “气候友好型鸡蛋”能成为下一类高端食品吗
article.background: 文章介绍通过再生农业生产的“气候友好型鸡蛋”：利用土壤、覆盖作物与放养体系减碳，并讨论消费者是否愿意为这种可持续属性支付溢价。

sentences.en: On a recent sunny day, 13,000 chickens roam over Larry Brown's 40 windswept acres in Shiner, Texas.
sentences.zh: 最近一个阳光明媚的日子里，1.3万只鸡在得州夏纳拉里·布朗那40英亩迎风的土地上自由活动。

segments.text: On a recent sunny day, 13,000 chickens roam over Larry Brown's 40 windswept acres in Shiner, Texas.

sentences.en: Some rest in the shade of a parked car.
sentences.zh: 有些鸡在停着的汽车阴影下休息。

segments.text: Some rest in the shade of a parked car.

sentences.en: Others drink water with the cows.
sentences.zh: 另一些则和奶牛一起喝水。

segments.text: Others drink water with the cows.

sentences.en: This all seems random, but it's by design, part of what the $6.1 billion U.S. egg industry bets will be its next big thing: climate-friendly eggs.
sentences.zh: 这一切看似随意，其实都是精心设计的，也是规模61亿美元的美国鸡蛋行业押注的下一件大事：气候友好型鸡蛋。

segments.text: This all seems random, but it's by design, part of what the $6.1 billion U.S. egg industry bets will be its next big thing: climate-friendly eggs.

sentences.en: These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases.
sentences.zh: 这些鸡蛋刚刚上市，每打售价最高达8美元；它们仍被标为有机、动物友好，但还来自采用再生型农业的农场——这种特殊技术通过培育肥沃土壤来吸收温室气体。

segments.text: These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases.

sentences.en: Such eggs could be marketed as helping to fight climate change.
sentences.zh: 因此，这类鸡蛋可以被宣传为有助于应对气候变化。

segments.text: Such eggs could be marketed as helping to fight climate change.

sentences.en: “I'm excited about our progress,” says Brown, who is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat.
sentences.zh: 布朗说：“我们的进展让我很兴奋。”他正在增加更多覆盖作物，以吸引蚯蚓和蟋蟀供鸡啄食。

segments.text: “I'm excited about our progress,” says Brown, who is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat.

sentences.en: The birds' waste then fertilizes fields.
sentences.zh: 鸡的排泄物随后又为土地施肥。

segments.text: The birds' waste then fertilizes fields.

sentences.en: Such improvements “allow our hens to forage for higher-quality natural feed that will be good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers.”
sentences.zh: 这些改进“让母鸡能够觅食质量更高的天然饲料，这对土地、母鸡以及我们供应给顾客的鸡蛋都有好处”。

segments.text: Such improvements “allow our hens to forage for higher-quality natural feed that will be good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers.”

sentences.en: The egg industry's push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering.
sentences.zh: 鸡蛋行业的这次推动，是首次大规模检验再生型农场的动物产品能否成为下一类高端商品。

segments.text: The egg industry's push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering.

sentences.en: In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart.
sentences.zh: 短短十多年里，有机鸡蛋从天然食品店里被轻视的小众商品，变成了沃尔玛也销售的产品。

segments.text: In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart.

sentences.en: More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories.
sentences.zh: 更近些时候，人们也曾同样怀疑益生菌和植物肉，但两者后来都迅速成长为超市中的重要品类。

segments.text: More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories.

sentences.en: If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond.
sentences.zh: 如果可持续鸡蛋推广成功，就可能为再生型牛肉、西兰花乃至更多产品打开闸门。

segments.text: If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond.

sentences.en: Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine.
sentences.zh: 宾州州立大学布兰迪万校区农业经济学副教授朱莉·斯坦顿说，再生型产品可能不容易卖，因为这个概念很难迅速解释清楚。

segments.text: Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine.

sentences.en: Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products, though some producers say their eggs have more protein.
sentences.zh: 这种农业方式对食品本身的改善也非常有限，甚至可能没有，尽管一些生产者声称鸡蛋含有更多蛋白质。

segments.text: Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products, though some producers say their eggs have more protein.

sentences.en: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability.
sentences.zh: 行业押注，那些愿意为散养、非转基因、牧场饲养等高端属性多付钱的消费者，也会接受可持续性。

segments.text: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability.

sentences.en: Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment.
sentences.zh: 调查显示，年轻一代更关注气候变化；植物肉的一部分成功，也可归因于消费者希望通过购买行为表达保护环境的愿望。

segments.text: Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment.

sentences.en: Young adults “really care about the planet,” says John Brunnquell, president of Egg Innovations.
sentences.zh: Egg Innovations公司总裁约翰·布伦奎尔说，年轻人“真的很关心这个星球”。

segments.text: Young adults “really care about the planet,” says John Brunnquell, president of Egg Innovations.

sentences.en: “They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing.”
sentences.zh: “他们确实正在改变食物链，改变的程度甚至超出了他们自己对所做之事的理解。”

segments.text: “They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing.”
